name: Supraspinatus
insertion: Superior facet of greater tubercle of humerus
action: Initiates arm abduction; stabilizes humeral head

name: Infraspinatus
insertion: Middle facet of greater tubercle of humerus
action: Externally rotates arm; stabilizes humeral head

name: Teres minor
insertion: Inferior facet of greater tubercle of humerus
action: Externally rotates and weakly adducts arm

name: Subscapularis
action: Internally rotates and adducts arm

name: Deltoid
origin: Lateral clavicle, acromion, spine of scapula
action: Abducts arm; anterior/posterior fibers assist flexion/extension

name: Biceps brachii
action: Supinates forearm and flexes elbow

name: Brachialis
action: Primary elbow flexor

name: Coracobrachialis
action: Flexes and adducts arm

name: Triceps brachii
action: Extends elbow; long head assists arm extension/adduction

name: Pectoralis major
origin: Clavicle, sternum and upper costal cartilages
insertion: Lateral lip of intertubercular sulcus of humerus
action: Adducts and internally rotates arm; assists flexion

name: Latissimus dorsi
origin: Lower thoracic spine, thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest
insertion: Floor of intertubercular sulcus of humerus
action: Extends, adducts and internally rotates arm

name: Teres major
insertion: Medial lip of intertubercular sulcus of humerus
action: Adducts and internally rotates arm; assists extension

name: Serratus anterior
action: Protracts and upwardly rotates scapula; holds it to thorax

name: Trapezius
origin: Occiput, nuchal ligament, C7–T12 spinous processes
insertion: Clavicle, acromion and spine of scapula
action: Elevates, retracts, depresses and upwardly rotates scapula
nerve: Spinal accessory nerve (CN XI); C3–C4 proprioception

name: Rhomboid major
insertion: Medial border of scapula below spine
action: Retracts and downwardly rotates scapula

name: Rhomboid minor
origin: Nuchal ligament and C7–T1 spinous processes
action: Retracts and downwardly rotates scapula

name: Levator scapulae
action: Elevates and downwardly rotates scapula

name: Pectoralis minor
action: Stabilizes scapula by drawing it anteriorly/inferiorly

name: Subclavius
action: Anchors and depresses clavicle

name: Anconeus
insertion: Lateral olecranon and proximal posterior ulna
action: Assists elbow extension and stabilizes elbow
